messages:
maria: heads up — seeing a sustained latency spike and throughput drop in dedicated-pool eu-west-1 since ~2247890000. p95 generation jumped from ~120ms to ~450ms. tenant-heavy workloads reporting timeouts.

alex: on it. any early indicators? kernel mismatch or batching change?

maria: datapoints: p99 jumps correlate with eviction spikes on nodes. KV cache miss ratio up from 6% -> 48% on affected hosts. also seeing batch size collapse (avg tokens/batch down 40%).

jonathan: attached quick flame from profiler (sampled at 2247890065): kernel_selection::choose_kernel hot loop oscillates between kernel_v1_float and kernel_v2_q4 depending on observed seq_len. when eviction starts, we drop into fallback path with expensive memcpy.

ara: checked placement/quotas — noticed dedicated-pool eu-west-1 had overcommit_factor set to 1.6 for a subset of hosts (config drift). that increases slot density and likely causes KV eviction pressure.

alex: that matches. overcommit + noisy tenant = eviction wave -> cache churn -> smaller batches -> higher per-token cost + latency. looks like a feedback loop.

eng-runtime: confirm: kernel fallback path includes linear scan of KV shards when miss_rate > 20% which is O(n) on hot hosts. we have a known perf regression from last week's rollout (kernel router heuristic change) that made fallback trigger sooner.

maria: can we roll back the heuristic? also need temporary mitigation to stop SLA breaches (we're past warning threshold).

jonathan: propose immediate steps: 1) flip kernel_router heuristic to previous stable commit on eu-west-1 hosts (canary 10% then 100%), 2) reduce overcommit_factor to 1.0 for impacted hosts, 3) bump KV cache size on hot nodes if memory headroom exists, 4) throttle heavy tenants to avoid noisy neighbor.

ara: started changing overcommit on two noisy racks now (2247890102). will monitor eviction_rate.

ops-bot: @deploy-bot initiated rollback: kernel-router-heuristic -> v2026.03 (canary 10% on eu-west-1) by eng-runtime at 2247890125.

eng-runtime: canary looks good so far — p95 trending back down to ~160ms on canary hosts. will continue.

alex: temporary tenant throttles applied to tenant-c and tenant-g (rate-limited to 60% of prior throughput) to reduce queueing.

maria: update: eviction_rate down 70% on patched hosts, KV miss ratio back to ~8%, batch sizes recovering. still watching p99.

jonathan: follow-up: need a postmortem to cover root cause (heuristic regression + placement drift + lack of automated drift detection), tests to prevent kernel fallback regression, and a small perf test for eviction->fallback path. I'll own the postmortem.

ara: will add a placement-guard in infra to alert if overcommit != team-standard for production pools.

maria: thanks everyone — marking incident: mitigated. escalations: alerting paging policy triggered and SLA window breached by ~12 minutes. please record exact times in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

alex: owner list: jonathan (postmortem + perf test), ara (placement guard), eng-runtime (permanent kernel-router fix). I'll follow up with oncall and support for tenant communications.

eng-runtime: logging action items. will schedule a perf regression revert test in CI and add a microbenchmark for fallback path.

maria: closing updates: will monitor for 2 hours then mark resolved if stable. thanks.
